evidence_policy: Candidate links are exact inventory-ID or file/line matches in existing research ledgers, not passes or equivalent workflows. Canonical historical status is retained verbatim. Exact expanded steps and example parameters govern every row. All 2700 unit cases remain in test-case-map.json; whole API obligations, inherited/underscore-prefixed/untested members remain in public-api-map.json and upstream-api-inventory.json. Original content/assets and J01-J10 security/language mappings govern all adaptations.

reviewed_sdk_evidence.title: saves a newly inserted table through its presentation owner
reviewed_sdk_evidence.equivalence: Synchronous add_table returns a live GraphicFrame for 2x2 cells at left 1in, top 2in, width 3in, height 1in. Saved package text, grid sizes and reopened table state are independently asserted. Initial slide creation uses the byte API; this does not cover Slides.add_slide.
